name: MMRVNS vaccine
sort_evidence: NCT07742644 (not yet recruiting) tests an investigational combined measles, mumps, rubella and varicella vaccine built on GSK's unapproved varicella new strain, a combined product the book does not hold, in the way ProQuad sits apart from Varivax.
